greeting.text: Um… are you, by any chance, from 302?

lines.text: I'm in 402. We've been pretty loud lately, huh…
I just moved in, so I've been unpacking at night… sorry.
If you hear thumping at night, just let me know.
Honestly, running into people in the elevator is awkward for me too.
I put down some floor mats. It should be better from this weekend.
Oh, your cat… I saw it in the window. So cute.

flushRemark.text: Uh… are you okay? Sorry, I shouldn't have kept you.

closers.satisfied: Glad I said hi. Take care!
closers.endured: I talked too long. Have a good one.
closers.sos: Oh, go ahead and take that!
